items.guidance: In an Express app, register the route on the app instance in the main server file before any passport/auth, helmet-style host checks, or custom-domain redirect middleware, so the probe is not redirected. Use a path that does not collide with short-link slug matching (e.g. place it before the catch-all `/:id` link handler), since this app resolves arbitrary paths as short URLs.

Check where bull queues are created and where `.process()` is called, and whether that module is imported by the web server started via `npm start`. Report whether consumers run in the web process or in a separate entry file, and whether any package.json script or Procfile already starts it. Also report whether the queues need Redis connection settings that are not provided by Deployz.
